---
applyTo: "**/*.kt,**/*.py,**/*.ts,**/*.tsx,**/*.java,**/*.tf"
---

Read AGENTS.md and the relevant contract before editing. Test actual behavior and
negative cases. Keep secrets and raw user messages out of source, fixtures and logs.
Money is deterministic integer minor units with currency; authorization and sharing
are default-deny. Use a separate non-author review and keep runtime boundaries intact.
